answer: One sybil defense is an attestation cold-start gate: an identity only gains voting weight after answering a signed cipher challenge for N straight epochs. A fresh fake identity leaves no attestation plume, so it sways nothing at first. Joining to influence is a canyon: an attacker must keep thousands of dummy agents online and solving challenges, paying compute all the way. Slashing a ring caught voting in lockstep burns its stake and history, widening that canyon. Honest agents cross once and keep cheap permanent influence; attackers pay it per clone, forever.
